about: Sprite-family art bindings, read by UDinkArtFamilySubsystem at screen activation and by Scripts/art_coverage.py. Visual only: placements keep their collision, hardness, origin IDs and scripts. Precedence: origin and screen bindings in the other Data/Art manifests win; a sequence row with a `frame` (one picture) wins over a class id row, which wins over a plain sequence row. fit none (the default): real-size meshes standing at the card's ground point, like the player and the dressed screens. Rules: SourceAssets/Art/ART_STANDARD.md. Optional `variants` (further mesh paths): a placement picks the main mesh or a variant by a stable hash of its origin ID. Optional `yaw_offset` (degrees) is added to the chosen yaw. Optional `anchor` ("card" default, "hardbox", "hardbox_inner"; physical mapping 15 Nov 2026, DinkFamilyAnchor.h) stands the mesh on the placement's 1997 hardbox (its centre, or for thin wall modules its face towards the screen's middle) instead of the card's ground point; presentation only. Optional `anchor_front` (0..1) stands the mesh's front edge, not its centre, on the sprite's bottom edge. Optional `span` ("width" or "height" for edge-on strips): the module is repeated along its X axis and scaled along X only until it fills that dimension of the layout-scaled card (interior wall runs: the kit is 0.025 m per pixel, interiors are laid out at 0.0438); `span` "stretch" scales one module along X to the card width (the arch); `span_fill` is the mesh of the further modules and `span_end` (left/right) the end the main mesh keeps. Scripted placements keep their card unless the row has `scripted` true; optional `scripted_scripts` (DinkC script names) dresses only the scripted placements whose script is listed, for scripts read to never change, move or remove their own sprite (they may talk, set hardness or make the sprite inactive, which hides the whole actor).
